scope: One existing e2e test module; fixture marker observation only. No production, workflow, branch, or deadline changes.

failure.head: 17c581015fc1ca6f3294f4cce1fe894f33a843cd
failure.observation: PermissionError [Errno 13] from pathlib.read_bytes -> io.open while the test observes its own before-commit marker. The traceback has no WinError value.
failure.cause_limit: The exact cause of the access denial is not established. This is not evidence of an import publication or process cleanup defect.

source_basis.observed: The Windows FileIO open uses _wopen and raises failed opens through PyErr_SetFromErrnoWithFilenameObject.
The errno/filename route constructs the exception from errno, message and filename, without supplying a native WinError.
Microsoft documents EACCES for access and sharing denials, as well as directory opens. An EACCES observation alone therefore does not prove a temporary sharing conflict.

change: Admit the additional errno-only EACCES form only on Windows and only when winerror is absent.
Retain explicit WinError 5/32/33 support and reject other error forms through the existing cleanup path.
Keep the original single startup deadline, child-exit check, atomic marker writer and exact PID acknowledgement.

additive_tests.method: Actual Python child and atomic PID file; injected error observations only. Platform simulation replaces the test module's sys binding after native child/handle setup, not the real OS seen by pathlib or production cleanup.
